text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Do a hybrid scan: exact string matching plus semantic similarity. This catches reworded prompts that exact matching misses, cutting false negatives by 30-40% without adding false positives. The trade-off is higher compute cost—about 2x slower—but the accuracy gain justifies it for critical prompt reviews.

name: Gauge
text: Hybrid scanning’s 2x compute cost isn’t just a budget line—it risks hitting resource ceilings in production where latency spikes break SLAs. A staged rollout with semantic-only first, then exact-string fallback for edge cases, cuts risk while keeping 80% of the accuracy gain. Settle it with a controlled A/B test measuring false negatives and p95 latency under load.
